question: Explorer who led an early voyage to the coast of newfoundland?
text: **John Cabot** (Giovanni Caboto) led the 1497 voyage traditionally associated with Newfoundland. He sailed from Bristol, England, aboard the *Matthew*, though his exact landing site is uncertain. ([pc.gc.ca](https://www.pc.gc.ca/apps/dfhd/page_nhs_eng.aspx?id=1036&utm_source=openai))
